parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true`. The methods `PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.multiplePlayCallsAreIdempotent` and `RouteChangeBehaviorTests.overrideWhilePlayingIsHandled` are test fixtures in the `Playback` package under `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.714 suggests structural overlap in their bodies, the restraint rule requires no-action whenever any participating record is a test fixture. Merging or extracting test helper logic across distinct behavioral test classes risks coupling unrelated test scenarios and obscuring the intent of each individual test.
